code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); objs=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            col=grid[r][c]
            if col==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==col:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            minr=min(y for y,x in cells); maxr=max(y for y,x in cells); minc=min(x for y,x in cells); maxc=max(x for y,x in cells)
            objs.append((minc,minr,col,[(y-minr,x-minc) for y,x in cells],maxr-minr+1,maxc-minc+1))
    objs.sort()
    out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]; top=left=0
    for i,(_,_,col,cells,oh,ow) in enumerate(objs):
        if i:
            ph,pw=prev
            top+=ph-1; left+=pw-1
        for y,x in cells:
            if top+y<h and left+x<w: out[top+y][left+x]=col
        prev=(oh,ow)
    return out
'''
